findings.body: If an unsigned prototype PR contains the accepted sign-off, `forge merge` can merge it and then fail during remote branch or worktree cleanup. On retry, this permission check sees the new sign-off on the default branch and refuses before reaching the merged-PR cleanup path at `src/forge/merge.py:92-124`. `forge close` only reports that the PR merged (`src/forge/close.py:278-289`), leaving no Forge command to finish cleanup.
findings.title: Allow merge cleanup after the sign-off PR lands

findings.body: `src/forge/nextstep.py:304,317` still reads the raw merge setting, so `forge next` tells an unsigned client prototype configured with `merge = "human"` to wait for a human merge. `src/forge/templates/skill.md:41-43` gives the agent the same outdated rule. The changed Tasks table assigns these paths and their tests to TALK after MERGE.
findings.title: Later: TALK must update forge next and agent guidance

findings.body: Done-when item 1 requires an accepted decision recording the owner's choice to merge prototypes until sign-off. No such decision appears under `docs/decisions/`; the changed Tasks table assigns that decision and its checklist test to SPEC.
findings.title: Later: SPEC must record the owner's merge decision
